attention4.ptxt: As the TCM consists of precision parts, the TCM will be damaged if it is exposed to an excessively large impact.
Handle the TCM carefully so as not to impact it.

attention3.ptxt: When TCM is removed or replaced, perform TCM Learning Value Clearance , Neutral Position Calibration and TCM Learning Value Initialization .

s1.ptxt: With select lever in P range, apply parking brake and block wheels.
Remove battery and battery tray.
Remove select cable clip and disconnect select cable from manual select lever.
Move manual select lever (1) to “N” position (2), and then remove manual select lever.

attention4.ptxt: If torque is applied to the manual shaft when loosening the manual select lever nut, internal part of the A/T may be damaged.
Fix the manual select lever in place before loosening the manual select lever nut.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect connector (1) from TCM (2).
Remove TCM bolts, and then pull TCM straight up to remove it.
Install solenoid harness connector (1) to transaxle case correctly.
Install TCM by pushing it straight into transaxle case, and then tighten TCM bolts (1) to specified torque.
Check that “N” mark (1) is aligned with matchmark (2).
If not aligned, remove TCM, set manual shaft in “N” position, and then repeat this Step 2) – 3).
Connect connector to TCM.
Install manual select lever and tighten manual select lever nut (1) to specified torque.

attention4.ptxt: If torque is applied to the manual shaft when tightening the manual select lever nut, internal part of the A/T may be damaged.
Fix the manual select lever in place before tightening the manual select lever nut.

s1.ptxt: Apply grease to pin and cable joint.
Install select cable to manual select lever.
Install clip (1).
Shift select lever to P range.
Install battery tray and battery.
After replacing TCM with new one, program TCM with calibration data. Refer to Operator’s Manual of SUZUKI ECU Programming System.

attention3.ptxt: Supplied TCM may not be programed depending on the shipping time. When a blank TCM is shipped with a memo indicating that “This ECU does not function without the calibration data.”, programing of the TCM with the calibration data is necessary for the activation.

s1.ptxt: Perform TCM Learning Value Clearance .
Perform Neutral Position Calibration .
Perform TCM Learning Value Initialization .
